tool.name: SPICE Clones
tool.description: classify clones from a supported IQ-TREE tree

configfiles.configfile: #import json #set $argv = ['clones', '--tree', 'supported-tree.nwk', '--output_directory', 'out', '--prefix', 'spice', '--clone_cut_mode', str($clone_cut_mode), '--root_method', str($root_method)] #if $outgroup and str($outgroup).strip(): #silent $argv.extend(['--outgroup', str($outgroup)]) #end if #if str($clone_cut_threshold) not in ('None', ''): #silent $argv.extend(['--clone_cut_threshold', str($clone_cut_threshold)]) #end if #silent $argv.extend(['--uf_support_threshold', str($uf_support_threshold)]) #silent $argv.extend(['--sh_support_threshold', str($sh_support_threshold)]) #silent $argv.extend(['--branch_cut_min', str($branch_cut_min)]) #silent $argv.extend(['--branch_cut_max', str($branch_cut_max)]) #silent $argv.extend(['--branch_cut_step', str($branch_cut_step)]) #silent $argv.extend(['--min_trusted_ratio', str($min_trusted_ratio)]) #silent $argv.extend(['--min_partition_stability', str($min_partition_stability)]) #silent $argv.extend(['--stability_window', str($stability_window)]) #silent $argv.extend(['--min_tips', str($min_tips)]) ${json.dumps({'argv': $argv, 'stage': [(str($tree), 'supported-tree.nwk')]})}

param.label: Outgroup tip names, separated by commas

validator.message: Outgroup names cannot contain control characters

param.label: Manual clone cutoff (required in manual mode)

tool.help:
Use the supported treefile output of IUC IQ-TREE 2.4.0+galaxy2, Tool Shed owner iuc, repository iqtree, revision e727e82945af. Node support labels are interpreted in SH-aLRT/UFBoot order. SPICE Clones performs no tree inference.
Defaults match SPICE, including midpoint rooting, automatic cutoff selection and minimum 50 tips. Supplying outgroup names takes precedence over root_method. Use commas between multiple outgroup tips. Root method none requires an already rooted input. Manual selection requires a nonnegative cutoff.
The list collection discovers SPICE's exported Clone_N.nwk files. Element IDs are Clone_N, exactly matching the assignment table. Map Ancestry over this collection with the full states table; preserve the same collection for Plasticity.
